name: io.github.pulpminercom/pulpminer-mcp
title: PulpMiner
description: Turn any public webpage into JSON with AI, save it as a live JSON API, and call it from your agent.

environmentVariables.name: PULPMINER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your PulpMiner API key (PulpMiner dashboard > API Keys). The only credential the server needs.

environmentVariables.name: PULPMINER_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: PulpMiner API base URL. Leave unset to use https://api.pulpminer.com.

environmentVariables.name: PULPMINER_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds. Scraping plus the AI step can take a while.
